checked_scope: The radial DSIC payment identity and the density-transformed virtual-surplus upper bound.
checks: DSIC utility is convex Lipschitz and u(0)=0 follows jointly from nonnegative payments and ex-post IR. Along each ray its a.e. derivative is v dot x(tv), giving the exact radial payment integral for every endpoint.

Transformation w=tv contributes t^-2 Jacobian and t^-1 from v_j, so K_f(w)=integral_(max w)^1 t^-3 f(w/t)dt. Tonelli gives integral w_j K_f=integral v_j f and ensures signed-density integrability despite origin singularity.

Where f=0, discarded coefficient is -v_j K_f<=0, so density division is used only on positive-density sets and yields an upper bound. Pointwise item-feasibility relaxation is finite and <= efficient welfare; uniform-square K_f=(r^-2-1)/2 checks algebra. No truthful implementation of relaxed allocation follows.
